title: Recovering Business Rules as Cascade Lookups for Enterprise Field Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.34258v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Enterprise sales-order systems rely on manually maintained configuration rules to determine fields such as payment terms, shipping points, and sales ownership. When these rules are incomplete or stale, operators must enter values by hand, and downstream errors spread into billing, logistics, and reporting. This paper studies whether missing or outdated rules can be recovered from historical transactions instead of being relearned as opaque statistical patterns. We introduce a knowledge-graph-guided workflow in which an LLM agent proposes candidate business keys, meaning column combinations such as customer and document type, validates them through SQL profiling, and compiles the resulting evidence into deterministic cascade lookups. The LLM is used only during offline rule discovery. At inference time, prediction is a transparent key lookup with no model-serving requirement. translated_title: 将业务规则恢复为级联查找以实现企业字段预测
translated_abstract: 企业销售订单系统依赖人工维护的配置规则来确定付款条件、发货点和销售归属等字段。当这些规则不完整或过时时，操作人员必须手动输入数值，而下游的错误会扩散到计费、物流和报表中。本文研究是否可以从历史交易中恢复缺失或过时的规则，而不是将其重新学习为不透明的统计模式。我们提出了一种知识图谱引导的工作流，其中LLM智能体提出候选业务键（即诸如客户和单据类型之类的列组合），通过SQL剖析对其进行验证，并将所得证据编译为确定性的级联查找。LLM仅在离线规则发现阶段使用。在推理时，预测是一个透明的键查找过程，无需模型服务支撑。在企业销售订单预测和公开数据集上的实验……
tldr: 本文提出一种知识图谱引导的LLM工作流，从历史交易中自动恢复企业业务规则并编译为确定性的级联查找，使字段预测在推理时无需模型服务且完全透明可解释。
